faqs.question: The colors on my printouts do not match the colors on my computer monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following recommended color correction methods:
Use ICC profiles during the color management process.
Ensure that you are using the correct output profile for your loaded media.
Note:
You may need to create a custom ICC profile for the best results.
Ensure that your monitor is calibrated and is displaying accurate color.
Compare the print result with the image on your computer screen in a well-lit environment. Since monitors and printers produce colors differently, printed colors and screen colors do not always look the same.
If the recommendations above do not help, contact Epson support.
The color management process is complex. We can assist you with the proper assignment of settings; however, we cannot assist you with creating a custom color profile.

faqs.question: I see the message Communication Error when I use a USB connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Delete all print jobs in the print queue.
Turn the printer off.
Note:
Make sure the USB cable is connected correctly.
Restart your computer. When the desktop appears, turn your printer on and follow the on-screen instructions.
Note:
If the problem continues, turn the printer off again and delete the printer in the list of printers. Then disconnect the USB cable from the printer and connect it again.

faqs.question: I see horizontal or vertical lines in my printout. What should I do?
faqs.answer:

If there are gaps in the nozzle check pattern, clean the print head nozzles.
If there are no gaps in the nozzle check pattern, try the solutions below.
Horizontal Banding
Increase the print resolution.
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Select an alternate paper profile for ink coverage.
Select the correct paper type in the printer driver.
Adjust the paper feed
Vertical Banding
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Align the print head.

faqs.question: How do I dispose of the waste ink from my product?
faqs.answer:
See
Disposing of Waste Ink
.
Warning:
Before handling the waste ink, read the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) for your printer.
The waste ink from the printer is industrial waste so you must dispose of it according to the industrial waste disposal laws and ordinances of your local government. Consign disposal of waste inks to an industrial waste disposer. Please provide the Waste Ink Data Sheet to the industrial waste disposer. See Safety Data Sheets/PIS to download a copy.

faqs.question: What is the smallest dot size that can be printed?
faqs.answer: The GS6000 can produce a dot size as small as 3.7 picoliters.  However, since the printer uses variable dot size technology, not every dot fired will be at 3.7 picoliters.

faqs.question: Does my product have a pressurized ink delivery system?

faqs.question: Does my product use ECO-solvent ink?
faqs.answer: No. The Epson Stylus Pro GS6000 uses UltraChrome GS Ink Technology.  This is an eight color solvent-based ink specifically designed for the Epson Stylus Pro GS6000.

faqs.question: Does my product use UltraChrome K3 inks?
faqs.answer: No. The printer uses solvent ink specifically designed for this product.

faqs.question: How do I dispose of expended ink cartridges?
faqs.answer: Dispose of expended ink cartridges in accordance with local laws and regulations.  Refer to the SDS for information on the contents of each ink cartridge. See Safety Data Sheets/PIS to download a copy.

faqs.question: What size ink cartridges does my product use?
faqs.answer: The printer uses 950 ml ink cartridges. The initial ink cartridges that come with the printer are 350 ml starter cartridges.

faqs.question: Can I hot-swap the ink cartridges?
faqs.answer: Yes, the ink cartridges are hot-swappable so you can replace them while you're printing.

faqs.question: How do I obtain additional maintenance kits?
faqs.answer: You can order additional printer maintenance kits (part number C12C890611) from the Epson Store.

faqs.question: Do I need any optional supplies to perform regular maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes, you will need the Print Head Cleaning Kit (part number C12C890621) to clean the wiper, cap assemblies and print-head casings.

faqs.question: When and how should I perform maintenance on my product?
faqs.answer:
The Epson Stylus Pro GS6000 requires regular maintenance for optimum performance. Regular maintenance also reduces the amount of ink required for cleaning cycles and minimizes printer “downtime”. See the following for maintenance instructions:
Cleaning the print head
Cleaning the cleaning wiper, capping assemblies, and print head casing
Drain waste ink
Replacing the ink flushing pad

faqs.question: How do I load media into my product?
faqs.answer:
Load media into the rear of the printer. Make sure the roll of media is centered with the arrow mark on the back of the printer before loading. See

faqs.question: How do I know what temperature I should select for the heaters?
faqs.answer: Check your media packaging for heater temperature settings. Be sure to set the correct temperature to prevent print quality problems.

faqs.question: In which direction can the Auto Take-Up Reel move?
faqs.answer: The Auto Take-Up Reel rolls the media only in a forward direction.

faqs.question: Are carrying bars necessary to mount my product onto my product stand?
faqs.answer: Carrying bars are not required to mount the printer, but are recommended to make the installation easier. You can use steel pipes from a local hardware store to mount the printer; we recommend pipes with a maximum diameter of 1 inch and a length of 84 inches.

faqs.question: Does my product have a unit ID code?
faqs.answer: Yes. You'll find it in the Epson Preferred booklet that comes with your printer.

faqs.question: Where is my product's manual cutting guide?
faqs.answer:
The manual cutting guide is located on top of the post heater.
Warning:
Do not place your fingers in the path of the cutting tool to avoid injuring yourself.

faqs.question: How do I get service for my product I purchased in another country?
faqs.answer:
Due to differences in products sold in other countries, printers need to be serviced in the country of origin. See
www.epson.com
to find support in your country.

faqs.question: How many heaters are in my product?
faqs.answer: The printer has three heaters: pre, platen, and post.

faqs.question: What do the 3 bars in the lower right corner of my product's LCD indicate?
faqs.answer: The 3 thermometer icons indicate the current temperature level for the pre, platen, and post heaters in the printer.

faqs.question: Is my product stand included with my product?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: Where can I obtain the SDS or WIDS sheets?
faqs.answer: See Safety Data Sheets/PIS to download a copy.

faqs.question: What does the "A" and "B" on top of a printed nozzle check indicate?
faqs.answer: Each color uses 360 nozzles that are divided into two rows of 180 nozzles. When printing a nozzle check, each row produces its own nozzle check indicated by the "A" and "B" on top. This allows you to identify which row of nozzles is clogged and needs cleaning.

faqs.question: How should I transport my product?
faqs.answer:
You must carefully prepare the printer for transportation as described in
Moving or Transporting the Printer
. You may need to perform maintenance procedures before transport, depending on how long the printer will be idle.

faqs.question: How do I cut off my prints?
faqs.answer:
Follow these steps to manually cut off your prints:
Make sure
READY
appears on the LCD display.
Press
or
to adjust the cutting position of the media, if necessary. (When you are using the Auto Take-Up Reel, you cannot feed the media backward.)

.

faqs.question: How many nozzles does my product use for each color?
faqs.answer: There are 360 nozzles per color.

faqs.question: How do I use the Auto Take-Up Reel on my product?
faqs.answer:
See
Using the Auto Take-Up Reel
.

faqs.question: What is the minimum and maximum supported paper width I can use with my product?
faqs.answer: The minimum roll media width is 12 inches and the maximum roll width is 64 inches.  Cut sheet media is not supported.

faqs.question: Is an extended warranty available for my product?
faqs.answer: Yes, two plans are available: One-Year extended warranty (part# EPPGS6KB1, MSRP $4425.00) and a Two-Year extended warranty (part# EPPGS6KB2, MSRP $8725.00).

faqs.question: What transfer speed does the built-in Ethernet interface support?
faqs.answer: The speed is 10/100/1000Base-T, and the printer will automatically connect to the fastest speed based on your network.

faqs.question: Which interfaces does my product support?
faqs.answer: It includes one Hi-speed USB 2.0 (1.1 compatible) and one Gigabit Ethernet Port (10/100/1000Base-T).

faqs.question: Where can I find my product's serial number?
faqs.answer: The serial number is located on a tag below the bar code label on the back of the printer.

faqs.question: What type of Ethernet cable should I use if I have a Gigabit switch or network?
faqs.answer: Use a Cat6 cable.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.
